policy.pose_intrinsics: Geometric mean of old focal entries; mean principal point; same fixed lens assumption
policy.map: Old fitted training points remain fixed; validation points triangulated only from old validation observations
policy.identity: New assistant-read RGB membership clicks; never world projections or cross-view point identities
policy.independence: New images and target clicks; localization remains conditional on old map and K. SIFT descriptor support can cross pixel masks.
